pr_body:
Updates the CSIP API to follow the same structure as VCP and MICP. 

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/45625
pr_comments: Compliance won't pass due to this bug: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/51259

> Compliance won't pass due to this bug: #51259

Does it mean this PR will not be merged before that bug is fixed?

> > Compliance won't pass due to this bug: #51259
> 
> Does it mean this PR will not be merged before that bug is fixed?

It means that we will need to either A) override the false-positive or B) rewrite the (otherwise correct code) to pass the check or C) wait for the check to be fixed or D) remove the check from CI

A) will be easiest to do for this PR.
Got tired of the CI error, so refactored the code.

> Did you consider to shorten the `coordinator` to `coord`, and maybe `member` to `mbr`

I've been asking around for abbreviations for those, as I do think they are quite long, but haven't found any good contenders for abbreviations for those 2. 

For example `coord` is used as an abbreviation for "coordinates" in Zephyr, and `mbr` is used for "master boot record". 

Ideally I'd like to use abbreviations that does not clash with other abbreviations in Zephyr.
@alwa-nordic @kruithofa @MariuszSkamra You've all previously approved this. Will you please re-review?
